name: quoxbuild
tagline: Green only after the service answered.
description: A governed build queue for your dev servers. A dispatch names a target the host already registered, never a command, so the build path can never become a remote shell. Builds serialise and coalesce, every outcome writes a witnessed receipt, and a receipt only reads green once a post-deploy probe confirms the service actually came up. Repeated failures are recorded, so the next dispatch of a target warns you before you approve it.
shortDescription: Governed build queue with verified receipts for dev servers
author: QUOX
_pricingNote: PROVISIONAL. DEVSUITE plan keeps bundle SKU + final pricing owner-gated; this figure exists so the manifest is well-formed and the plugin can be enabled, not as an approved price.
dashboardSurfaceNote: No standalone route by design: the build queue is reached from its host card in /dev-suite via a capability pill, because a build queue belongs to a host.
marketingPoints: Queued is not built, and built is not verified: a receipt goes green only after a probe answered
A dispatch can only name a pre-registered target, so the envelope can never carry a command
Parallel dispatches coalesce into one build whose receipt names both requesters
A killed build reports the failing step and exit code, never a hollow green
Repeated failures become a warning on the next dispatch, before you approve it
No model anywhere in the build path

governedDispatch.name: Signed dispatch, registered targets
governedDispatch.description: Dispatches are signed and delivered over the fleet gateway, and the host refuses any target it does not already know.

verifiedReceipts.name: Receipts that mean something
verifiedReceipts.description: Every build writes a durable receipt. Green requires a post-deploy check that the container is alive and, where a health endpoint exists, answering.

coalescing.name: Serialised and coalesced
coalescing.description: Concurrent requests for the same target become one build, so parallel sessions cannot race each other into a corrupted image.

failureLearning.name: It learns from its own receipts
failureLearning.description: A target that fails repeatedly records the pattern, and the next dispatch surfaces it before a human approves. Deliberately restrained: one red build is a typo, not a lesson.
